mentions.name: MacroCodex
mentions.description: A free, ad- and subscription-free weight loss app that estimates daily total calorie burn using a sensorless adaptive TDEE (total daily energy expenditure) tracking technique, which the author says is more accurate than wearables. It runs as a PWA on Android, iOS, and any other supporting platform, and includes a community of 2,000+ members.
mentions.problem: Wearables are claimed to be less accurate at estimating daily calorie burn; this provides sensorless tracking to support weight loss.
mentions.source_excerpt:
All this completely free, no subscription or ads: 
https://macrocodex.app/

MacroCodex also works on both Android and iOS and any platform where PWA app can run.
mentions.author: faangguyindia

mentions.name: MacroCodex
mentions.description: Free web app (no ads, subscriptions, or payments) that estimates a user's true maintenance calories (adaptive TDEE) over time based on calorie surplus/deficit and weight changes, guiding users to eat above the maintenance line to gain weight or below it to lose weight, with clear gain or loss expected within 2-5 weeks. Has 16k users and includes a knowledge section explaining the method.
mentions.source_excerpt:
MacroCodex uses that relationship to estimate your true maintenance calories over time: https://macrocodex.app/
This can be used to gain or lose weight. You simply need to eat above your maintenance calorie line to gain weight and below it to lose weight. No ads, no subscriptions, no payments, 16k users already.
mentions.author: faangguyindia
